interpretation.decisionUnit: Unique accepted scoped book; warmup and every outcome retained
interpretation.counterfactual: Independent flat-wallet entry probes using the preserved v1 label admission; not actual ML signals or a portfolio
interpretation.quoteUnchanged: Top bid/ask prices unchanged across adjacent accepted versions in one uninterrupted segment; not continuous persistence
interpretation.depthChange: Observed capacity difference at sampled levels; not proven replenishment or queue evidence
interpretation.nextPriceChange: Next sampled book change with corresponding gap distribution; not signal-conditioned execution quality
limitations: Overlapping probes are correlated and cannot be summed as portfolio PnL or independent trades
Open inventory and missing liquidation are retained; zero realized PnL on an open probe does not mean zero loss
Segment boundaries/outages suppress executable marks; stale or insufficient depth liquidation is unavailable
REST snapshots do not establish maker fills or effective independent sample size
Historical STOP-affected capture evidence still requires per-boundary audit; this report is exploratory
